title: Ankhorage Utility
summary: Provides shared functional utilities for Ankhorage packages and compatible external projects.
purpose: Centralize reusable runtime-neutral utility behavior so packages do not duplicate generic implementations.
responsibilities: Expose focused utility modules across collection, validation, serialization, networking, and platform topics.
Provide explicit public subpaths for reusable helpers.
boundaries: Does not own product-specific policy or feature behavior.
Does not provide application composition or provider configuration.
audience: Ankhorage packages and compatible external projects.
useCases: Reuse generic functional helpers through documented public subpaths.
Avoid duplicate utility implementations across packages.

invariants: Consumers use declared public subpaths rather than internal deep imports.

limitations: Utility semantics are generic and do not encode product-specific policy.
